subject: gk
question: Fundamental duties are mentioned in which part of the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Part IV-A**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Fundamental duties are listed in Part IV-A of the Indian Constitution.
 
• These duties were added by the 42nd Amendment Act in 1976.
 
• Article 51A of the Constitution specifies the list of Fundamental Duties.
 
• Originally, ten Fundamental Duties were included, and an eleventh duty was added by the 86th Amendment in 2002.
 
• These duties are moral obligations for all citizens to help promote a spirit of patriotism and to uphold the unity of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **42nd Amendment Act, 1976**

 
 
• Known as the "Mini-Constitution" due to its extensive changes to the Constitution.
 
• Added the Fundamental Duties in Part IV-A.
 
• Strengthened the power of the central government.
 
 
 
• **Article 51A**
 
 
• Lists the Fundamental Duties of citizens.
 
• Includes duties like respecting the National Flag and the Constitution, cherishing noble ideals of the freedom struggle, and promoting harmony.
 
 
 
• **86th Amendment Act, 2002**
 
 
• Added the 11th Fundamental Duty.
 
• The 11th duty emphasizes providing opportunities for education to children aged 6 to 14 years.
 
 
 
• **Directive Principles of State Policy**
 
 
• Listed in Part IV of the Constitution.
 
• These principles aim to create social and economic conditions under which citizens can lead a good life.
